question: The seat turn in LieDown a08 (50-57) and GetUp a02 (33-40) yaws the body 90 deg in 7 frames (about 770 deg/s); the right hand sweeps with it at up to 11.2 m/s. Accept it, or revise the request for longer LieDown/GetUp clips?

evidence.cause: the request's 90-frame clip contract (1.5 s) holds sit, put-down (>= 25%), release, scoot, knee straightening, turn and lie-back (bed support <= 70%)

options.title: Accept for now
options.what: keep LieDown a08 / GetUp a02 unchanged; the turn speed stays an accepted art note

options.title: Request revision (r7)
options.what: longer LieDown/GetUp clips (e.g. 150-180 frames) so the turn and the rest of the choreography can slow down; needs a request change and new attempts
